title: Large Fourier maximum has a large coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Set $T_n=2\sqrt{n}\,2^{-n/2}$. If the largest absolute value of a Fourier coefficient of $f$ exceeds $T_n$, then some Fourier coefficient has absolute value at least $T_n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
